body: Commits 83cf303/21a311a on main. New stunned_ms (hard CC: blocks movement/casting/auto-attack) and slowed_ms/slow_pct (proportional move-speed reduction) generic ArenaHero fields, referencing GoblinFoxDragon's server/status package (Paralyze/Slow). Closes a gap hero_status_label's own doc comment already flagged as missing. New arena_apply_stun/arena_apply_slow kit-wiring hooks, no kit uses them yet (infrastructure first, matching how silenced_ms/rooted_ms/burning_ms were built). Real bugfix found along the way: none of the 5 existing status-effect fields were ever synced over the wire -- the status label HUD has been silently non-functional in every networked match, same class of bug as the earlier w_active fix. Fixed for all 7 fields. 9 new tests, build clean, full suite green (568/568).
title: Generic Stun + Slow status effects, using GFD as reference (S170-184)
